title: What a backwoods string band near Dallas played in 1936
summary: A rural musician was still close to the blues, a few years behind the Doughboys, and copied them from radio. Mexican and Black influences met in Dallas.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
